page.overview:
Who is Chase?

Chase has three separate forms in the series: robot, vehicle and dinosaur. In robot mode, he can carry two passengers in his cabin, and has a spotlight in his forearms. He also has taser-like weapons in his arms. In vehicle mode, he is fast and agile, very much like a sports car. His dinosaur form is a stegosaurus, and he can electrify his tail, enabling him to stun opponents with a swipe or fire off taser blasts.
